plan.title: Add a bounded Android pack with real merged-manifest and resolved-dependency exports

criteria.description: The Android manifest loads namespaced manifest/dependencies surfaces and build check with explicit tool/platform requirements.
Public fixtures and adapter tests detect permission, component exported-state and resolved dependency changes; stable identifiers and deterministic sorting preserve equivalent output.

Missing, stale, duplicate, malformed, oversized, wrong-variant and unresolved exports, failed or cancelled builds, and concurrent builds cannot publish a successful candidate or reuse an older artifact. Missing declared tools produce not-run for the build check and failed/nonpassing surface extraction. Failed extraction invalidates the current candidate and preserves approved baseline bytes.

limitations: Only the public Java Android app/library example, debug variant, AGP 8.9.2, Gradle 8.11.1, JDK 17, compile/target SDK 35 and Build Tools 35.0.0 are in scope. No emulator, UI, device installation, signing or production project inspection.
Core Go behavior and Go dependencies remain unchanged. Python standard-library adapter supports macOS/Linux; Windows runtime support is not claimed.

requires detects missing declared executables or unsupported OS, not SDK contents or version compatibility. Missing sdkmanager produces not-run; an invalid SDK path, missing SDK package or incompatible version with executables present fails extraction. These outcomes must never become pass.

Default gate tests use bounded fixtures and do not download Android artifacts. Task completion additionally requires actual clean Android build/export, unchanged-repeat, permission/exported/dependency mutation detection, restoration and failure-no-reuse evidence with code revision, versions, commands and exits.
A successful build check proves build/export completion, not equality with an approved baseline. Baseline extract/diff/approve remain separate existing operations; no surface-to-mode integration.

Existing toolchains may be selected per command. Initial AGP artifact downloads may be required after task begin under the applicable user authorization. No emulator/SDK license acceptance, global settings edits, push, tag or release is implicit.
